parsed_entries.requirement: Electronic signatures must be uniquely linked to the signatory and under their exclusive control.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the electronic signature is uniquely linked to the signatory and under their exclusive control.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures are not misused or impersonated.

parsed_entries.requirement: Electronic signatures must be under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of signing.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the electronic signature was under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of signing.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures are not forged or misused.

parsed_entries.requirement: Any alteration to an electronically signed document must be detectable.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that any alteration to an electronically signed document is detectable.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronically signed documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures the integrity of electronically signed documents.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may establish procedures to verify the authenticity of electronic signatures.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Central Government has established procedures to verify the authenticity of electronic signatures.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures can be verified by authorized authorities.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may add or remove electronic signature techniques from the Second Schedule.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Central Government has the authority to add or remove electronic signature techniques from the Second Schedule.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic signature techniques used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement allows for the updating of electronic signature standards by the Central Government.

parsed_entries.requirement: Electronic records must be accessible for subsequent reference.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that electronic records are accessible for subsequent reference.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that electronic records remain usable for future reference.

parsed_entries.requirement: Electronic records must be usable in place of traditional written forms.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that electronic records are usable in place of traditional written forms.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all electronic records used in legal documents.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that electronic records are legally recognized as valid substitutes for traditional written forms.
